verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Pro is a silicon chip. It has no product UI whose actions could be mirrored through an API, so API–UI parity is a category error for this kind of product. Metal, Core ML and MLX are developer frameworks for programming the hardware. They are not a UI-parity API surface, so they do not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
